title: Atlees Declaration And Transfer Of Power
definition: The formal announcement by British PM Clement Attlee on February 20, 1947, setting a definitive deadline (June 1948) for the British withdrawal from India, marking the final phase of the decolonization process.
importanceInUpsc: This topic is critical for understanding the constitutional transition, the role of the Labour Party in post-WWII British policy, and the geopolitical compulsions leading to the Mountbatten Plan.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Atlees Declaration And Transfer Of Power.
